issues_detected.description: The record does not analyze how single-site recruitment, English-proficiency eligibility, non-verbal exclusion, recording-device differences or missing features could affect representation and intended uses.

semantic_insights: The record consistently distinguishes 23,533 recordings from 300 participants and distinguishes released audio features from original recordings.
Source caveats explicitly prevent adult-cohort statements and PhysioNet platform maintenance or funding statements from being attributed to the pediatric dataset.
Canadian REB oversight, consent and privacy screening are mutually consistent; a US-specific compliance claim is not presumed necessary.
Registered feature access and controlled raw-audio access are separately described, including their different approval and institutional-signature requirements.
The 1.1.0 issue date agrees with its documented release date, and the stated changes are compatible with no new participants being added.
Different feature counts are accompanied by an explanation that some recordings could not generate certain features; the record does not claim every feature has identical coverage.
The registered funding, access, software and population-characterization anchors are met without assuming that every author affiliation, dependency version or subgroup proportion is supplied.
All conditional applicability predicates remain unknown because applicability was not independently declared; dataset content was used as scoring evidence, not as an exclusion declaration.
